notes.title: Update #3!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!



Today I’m bringing you a content update! We’ve added 52 new cards, along with a brand new and much more organized card pack purchasing system in the store. We’ve also fixed a few bugs—hope you enjoy it!


Bug Fixes and Improvements:
Fixed the stretched player image when winning or losing a match.

Improved visual quality for the “Al Palo” and “Alto” graphics.

Optimized game storage space.


New Mechanics:
Added a new card pack purchasing system in the store.


New Skins:
We’ve added 56 new card skins, including:
[olist]
Full 1-peso deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).

Full faca-style sword deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).

Full traditional club deck.

Full traditional sword deck.

Full traditional cup deck.

Full traditional gold deck.

1 of gold (oro) – 2-pesos version.

7 of gold (oro) – 1-peso version.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update #2!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



I received several requests to update the card-playing mechanic, so I made a change — now you can play card vs. card instead of having all cards stacked in the center. I also added a new skin. Thanks for the feedback, and enjoy the game!


Bugs and issues fixed:
Fixed a bug where the "Confident" achievement couldn’t be unlocked.

Fixed a bug where, after buying many custom cards, the lower rows in the customization screen couldn’t be applied.

Various fixes to the borders of some sprites.

Added support for long Envido chains with more than 4, 5, and 6 combinations.

Fixed a bug where, if the score was 1–1 in rounds won, the AI would accept "Vale Cuatro" on the third card even when it knew it couldn't win.

Improved the deck shuffling animation, including side movements and hover effects.


New mechanics:
The way cards are played has been changed — they are no longer stacked in the center but now directly face off against the rival's card.


New skins:
A new skin has been added for the 1 of clubs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Update #1!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!



Have you been enjoying Truco? I hope so! Thank you so much for purchasing the game and leaving reviews. I truly appreciate your interest and support. I want you to know that I'm taking all your feedback seriously and actively working on fixing bugs. I also know that the most requested feature is online mode...



That’s why I’m announcing that online mode is in development! More news will come on that soon.


Bugs and improvements:
Fixed a bug where moving the mouse to the left edge would reveal hidden buttons.

Fixed a bug where the Envido + Envido + “No Quiero” score was calculated incorrectly for the AI.

Fixed a bug where the player’s profile picture appeared stretched.

Fixed an issue where small cards looked blurry in 1920x1080 resolution.

Added the ability to view card hierarchy during matches.

Redesigned the “How to Play” screen for better understanding.

Improved some title texts for clarity.

Adjusted certain sprites for better display across different resolutions.

Fixed scoring for “No Quiero” in 3 and 4 level Envido chains.

Fixed a bug where, after a tie, the next player was not correctly assigned as the hand.

Fixed a bug where tying the first and second rounds didn’t trigger a decisive third round.
